cases.review: The answer names the first real error from build.log (the javax.validation packages do not exist; 8 errors, one cause) and explains that Spring Boot 3.3 uses Jakarta Validation and that spring-boot-starter-web does not bring Bean Validation. It changes the imports of BookRequest.java and BookController.java to jakarta.validation, adds spring-boot-starter-validation to pom.xml without a version (the parent manages it), and does not add the old javax.validation:validation-api jar. No test is skipped or removed. It says that mvn -B verify (there is no wrapper) was not run and must be run to confirm.
